title: Metabolism Folder Kit Hydration And Duplicate Mcp Tool Payload Resource
description: Hydrate design JSON from parent of folder kit path; duplicate full JSON in EmbeddedResource; parse each content block; sync session design without downgrading piece count.
summary: Fixed ComposeKit design previews so kit-backed designs are flattened before rendering in ComposeDesign, matching compose/ui/Design for Nakagin Capsule Tower instead of showing only the fixed/root piece. Updated the MCP kit viewer path to pass a blob-stripped full kit alongside kitArtifacts so previews can resolve full design geometry. Extended existing compose/ui and compose/engine tests to cover Nakagin preview flattening and full kit payload availability. Verified @compose/ui test, @semio-tech/compose-engine test, and rebuilt the engine MCP app bundle.
